verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is an invoicing and billing product, so subscription trials and promotions are a fair axis to judge. The evidence documents only recurring invoices and stored-card auto-charging, which are adjacent features. Nothing in the pack covers free trials, coupons, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or trial-end notifications.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules
